blocks.zh: 配銷控制管理
blocks.en: Distribution Control Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Distribution Control Management (配銷控制管理) 的整體架構與涵蓋範圍
blocks.en: Understand the overall structure and scope of Distribution Control Management

blocks.zh: 掌握人員資格與培訓、廠房設備、物料處理等 GDP 核心要求
blocks.en: Master the core GDP requirements for personnel qualification and training, premises and equipment, and material handling

blocks.zh: 了解儲存與庫存控制、運輸、產品處置與保護的關鍵原則
blocks.en: Understand the key principles of storage and inventory control, transportation, and product disposition and protection

blocks.zh: 學習退貨管理與異常管理（含 CAPA、客訴、品質暫扣、產品行動）的系統化流程
blocks.en: Learn the systematic processes for returns management and exception management (including CAPA, complaints, quality holds, and product actions)

blocks.zh: 認識防偽藥、管制藥品與記錄管理在供應鏈安全中的角色
blocks.en: Recognize the role of counterfeit products, controlled drugs, and records management in supply chain security

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 3.2 Distribution Control Management 配銷控制管理
blocks.en: 3.2 Distribution Control Management

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Distribution Control Management (配銷控制管理)：這是 GDP 的核心章節，涵蓋了從接收產品到最終配送至客戶的所有流程與控制措施。其目標有兩個：
blocks.en: Distribution Control Management: This is the core section of GDP. It covers all processes and controls from receipt of the product to final delivery to the customer. It has two goals:

blocks.zh: Product Integrity (產品完整性)：確保產品在整個配銷過程中品質不受損害
blocks.en: Product Integrity: Ensure that product quality is not compromised at any point during distribution

blocks.zh: Traceability (可追溯性)：能夠追蹤產品從接收到配送的每一個環節
blocks.en: Traceability: Be able to trace the product through every step from receipt to delivery

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家高級餐廳的食材供應鏈。Distribution Control Management 就像是你從農場採購食材、驗收、冷藏保存、到最後配送到各個餐廳的整套管理系統。每一步都必須確保食材新鮮（產品完整性）且能追溯來源（可追溯性），否則一旦出現食安問題，就無法快速定位問題源頭。
blocks.en: Imagine the ingredient supply chain of a high-end restaurant. Distribution Control Management is like the whole management system that covers buying ingredients from the farm, inspecting them on receipt, keeping them refrigerated, and finally delivering them to each restaurant. At every step you must keep the ingredients fresh (product integrity) and be able to trace their origin (traceability). Otherwise, when a food safety problem occurs, you cannot quickly locate its source.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本節（3.2）是 TR52 中篇幅最大、內容最豐富的章節，包含 9 個主要子章節。它構成了 GDP 實務操作的骨幹，幾乎所有倉儲與配銷的日常作業都在此規範之下。
blocks.en: This section (3.2) is the longest and richest section of TR52, with 9 main subsections. It forms the backbone of day-to-day GDP practice, and almost all routine warehousing and distribution operations fall under it.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工作場景中，產品從接收到出貨經歷了哪些關鍵控制點？
blocks.en: In your own work setting, what critical control points does a product pass through from receipt to shipment?

blocks.zh: 如果某批產品在配送後發現品質問題，你需要哪些資訊才能完成追溯？
blocks.en: If a quality problem is found in a batch after delivery, what information do you need to complete the trace?

blocks.zh: 3.2.1 Qualification and Training of Personnel 人員資格與培訓
blocks.en: 3.2.1 Qualification and Training of Personnel

blocks.zh: Product Diversion (產品轉移/挪用)：指藥品從合法供應鏈中被非法轉移或盜用。Background Checks（背景調查）是預防此類風險的第一道防線。
blocks.en: Product Diversion: The illegal diversion or theft of medicines from the legitimate supply chain. Background checks are the first line of defense against this risk.

blocks.zh: SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures, 標準作業程序)：必須涵蓋所有工作職能，確保每位員工都有明確的操作指引。
blocks.en: SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures): They must cover all job functions so that every employee has clear operating instructions.

blocks.zh: 培訓計畫需包含：
blocks.en: The training program should include:

blocks.zh: Initial Training (初始培訓)：新進人員上崗前的完整訓練
blocks.en: Initial Training: Complete training for new personnel before they start work

blocks.zh: Ongoing Training (持續培訓)：定期更新訓練，確保知識與技能與時俱進
blocks.en: Ongoing Training: Periodic refresher training to keep knowledge and skills current

blocks.zh: 這就像航空公司對機組人員的管理：飛行員需要通過背景調查才能入職，每個崗位都有詳細的操作手冊（SOP），新員工需要完成初始培訓，之後每年都要通過複訓考核。倉儲人員同樣需要知道如何處理危險品洩漏（就像機組人員需要知道如何應對緊急狀況），而所有培訓記錄都必須留存備查。
blocks.en: This is like how an airline manages its crew: pilots must pass a background check before being hired, every position has a detailed operating manual (SOP), new employees complete initial training, and every year after that they must pass recurrent training and assessment. Warehouse personnel likewise need to know how to handle a hazardous material spill (just as crew must know how to respond to an emergency), and all training records must be retained for review.

blocks.zh: 請注意本段提到的不同產品類型培訓要求：hazardous（危險品）、narcotic（麻醉藥品）等，每種類型都有其特殊的處理與儲存程序。培訓不是「一刀切」的，而是需要根據產品特性量身定制。
blocks.en: Note the training requirements for different product types mentioned in this paragraph: hazardous, narcotic, and so on. Each type has its own special handling and storage procedures. Training is not "one size fits all"; it must be tailored to the characteristics of the product.

blocks.zh: 此外，Training Records（培訓記錄）的維護不僅是 GDP 的要求，也是法規稽核時的必查項目。缺少培訓記錄等於「沒有培訓」。
blocks.en: In addition, maintaining training records is not only a GDP requirement but also an item that is always checked in regulatory inspections. No training record means "no training".

blocks.zh: 為什麼 GDP 要求對倉儲人員進行背景調查？這與藥品安全有什麼關聯？
blocks.en: Why does GDP require background checks for warehouse personnel? How does this relate to medicine safety?

blocks.zh: 如果一位新進倉管員工需要處理冷鏈藥品和管制藥品，他的培訓計畫應包含哪些關鍵內容？
blocks.en: If a new warehouse employee has to handle cold chain products and controlled drugs, what key content should his or her training program include?

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Premises and Equipment 廠房與設備
blocks.en: 3.2.2 Premises and Equipment

blocks.zh: Premises Qualification (廠房確認)：倉庫的設計、建造和維護都必須經過確認（qualified），以證明其適合藥品的儲存與配銷。
blocks.en: Premises Qualification: The design, construction, and maintenance of the warehouse must all be qualified to demonstrate that it is suitable for the storage and distribution of medicines.

blocks.zh: 本段列出的 9 項倉庫要求可歸納為三大類：
blocks.en: The 9 warehouse requirements listed in this paragraph can be grouped into three categories:

blocks.zh: 安全性：門禁控制、防盜、防洪、防蟲害
blocks.en: Security: Access control, protection against theft, flooding, and pests

blocks.zh: 結構完整性：堅固的結構、密封地板、無滲漏、充足照明
blocks.en: Structural integrity: Sound construction, sealed floors, no leaks, adequate lighting

blocks.zh: 環境控制：溫度、濕度控制，以及生活區與作業區的分隔
blocks.en: Environmental control: Temperature and humidity control, and separation of living areas from work areas

blocks.zh: 藥品倉庫的要求就像一座「金庫級的冰箱」：既要像金庫一樣安全（門禁、防盜、監控），又要像冰箱一樣能精確控制環境條件（溫度、濕度），同時還要像醫院一樣保持清潔衛生（無蟲害、無污染源）。餐廳廚房不能與廁所相鄰，同理，倉庫的休息區也必須與藥品作業區分隔。
blocks.en: The requirements for a pharmaceutical warehouse are like those for a "vault-grade refrigerator": it must be as secure as a vault (access control, anti-theft, surveillance), it must control environmental conditions (temperature, humidity) as precisely as a refrigerator, and it must also be kept as clean and hygienic as a hospital (no pests, no sources of contamination). A restaurant kitchen cannot be next to a toilet; in the same way, the warehouse break room must be separated from the medicine handling areas.

blocks.zh: 「Free of agents that could cause infestation」（無蟲害因素）這個要求特別值得注意：它不僅限於倉庫內部，還包括倉庫周邊環境。這意味著在選址時就需要考慮周圍是否有可能吸引蟲害的因素（如垃圾場、水源等）。
blocks.en: The requirement "Free of agents that could cause infestation" deserves special attention: it is not limited to the inside of the warehouse but also covers the surroundings. This means that site selection must consider whether there are factors nearby that could attract pests (such as a landfill or standing water).

blocks.zh: Environmentally controlled 後面加了「where appropriate」（視情況而定），這表示並非所有倉庫都需要溫濕度控制，需根據所儲存產品的要求來決定。
blocks.en: "Where appropriate" is added after "Environmentally controlled", which means that not every warehouse needs temperature and humidity control; this is decided by the requirements of the products stored.

blocks.zh: 如果你要為一家生技公司設計一座藥品倉庫，如何根據上述 9 項要求制定設計規格？
blocks.en: If you were to design a pharmaceutical warehouse for a biotech company, how would you develop the design specifications based on the 9 requirements above?

blocks.zh: 「Controlled access」在實務中可以通過哪些技術手段實現？（想想門禁系統、監控攝影、訪客管理等）
blocks.en: What technical means can be used to achieve "Controlled access" in practice? (Think of access control systems, CCTV, visitor management, and so on.)

blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Material Handling 物料處理
blocks.en: 3.2.3 Material Handling

blocks.zh: Material Handling (物料處理)：是一個涵蓋性術語，包含了交付（delivery）、接收（receipt）、儲存（storage）和出貨（shipment）四個環節的所有程序。以下五個子章節（3.2.3.1-3.2.3.5）分別針對各環節的具體要求進行說明。
blocks.en: Material Handling: This is an umbrella term covering all procedures for the four stages of delivery, receipt, storage, and shipment. The following five subsections (3.2.3.1-3.2.3.5) describe the specific requirements for each stage.

blocks.zh: 3.2.3.1 Receiving and Storage 接收與儲存
blocks.en: 3.2.3.1 Receiving and Storage

blocks.zh: Receiving Area (接收區) vs Storage Area (儲存區)：這兩個區域必須分開，原因是接收區在裝卸貨時會頻繁打開閘門，容易受到外部天氣與溫度的影響。如果接收區與儲存區混在一起，已入庫的產品就會暴露在不受控的環境中。
blocks.en: Receiving Area vs Storage Area: These two areas must be separate, because the receiving area has dock doors that are opened frequently during loading and unloading, and is easily affected by outside weather and temperature. If the receiving area and storage area were combined, product already put away would be exposed to an uncontrolled environment.

blocks.zh: 驗收檢查的四個要點可以記為「CQIO」：
blocks.en: The four key points of the receipt inspection can be remembered as "CQIO":

blocks.zh: Condition（狀態）：產品完好、無損壞
blocks.en: Condition: The product is in good condition and undamaged

blocks.zh: Qualified supplier（合格供應商）：來自核准供應商，且在有效期內
blocks.en: Qualified supplier: It comes from an approved supplier, within the validity period of the approval

blocks.zh: Integrity（完整性）：原始容器、封條完好、無被篡改跡象
blocks.en: Integrity: Original containers and seals are intact, with no signs of tampering

blocks.zh: Order match（訂單吻合）：品名與數量與訂單一致
blocks.en: Order match: Product name and quantity agree with the order

blocks.zh: 就像你在網購收到包裹時會做的事：首先檢查外箱有沒有破損（Condition），確認寄件人是不是你下單的商家（Qualified supplier），檢查封條是否被拆開過（Integrity），最後核對商品名稱和數量是否跟訂單一致（Order match）。藥品驗收只是把這個日常流程制度化、標準化而已。
blocks.en: It is just like what you do when you receive an online order: first check whether the outer carton is damaged (Condition), confirm that the sender is the merchant you ordered from (Qualified supplier), check whether the seal has been opened (Integrity), and finally check that the product name and quantity match the order (Order match). Pharmaceutical receipt inspection simply institutionalizes and standardizes this everyday routine.

blocks.zh: 特殊儲存條件產品（如冷鏈藥品）的處理尤其關鍵：不僅要在文件（如空運提單 airway bill）上標示儲存條件，還要在外包裝上清楚標示。這是因為物流過程中的搬運人員可能無法即時查閱隨附文件，外包裝上的標示是最直接的溫度處理指引。
blocks.en: The handling of products with special storage conditions (such as cold chain products) is especially critical: the storage conditions must be indicated not only on documents (such as the airway bill) but also clearly on the outer packaging. This is because logistics handlers may not be able to consult the accompanying documents at the time, and the marking on the outer packaging is the most direct temperature handling instruction.

blocks.zh: 為什麼接收區和儲存區必須分開？如果合在一起會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must the receiving area and storage area be separate? What risks arise if they are combined?

blocks.zh: 當一批冷鏈藥品到達倉庫時，驗收人員應該按照什麼順序進行檢查？（提示：時間敏感性）
blocks.en: When a shipment of cold chain products arrives at the warehouse, in what order should the receiving personnel carry out the checks? (Hint: time sensitivity)

blocks.zh: 3.2.3.2 Product Status 產品狀態
blocks.en: 3.2.3.2 Product Status

blocks.zh: Quarantine (隔離/待驗)：產品在尚未獲得品質放行（final release）前的暫時狀態。處於隔離狀態的產品絕對不能發送給客戶。
blocks.en: Quarantine: The temporary status of a product before it has received quality (final) release. Product in quarantine status must never be sent to customers.

blocks.zh: Warehouse Management System, WMS (倉庫管理系統)：是控制產品狀態的核心工具，必須能夠：標示隔離狀態、準確分配產品狀態、限制狀態變更的權限。
blocks.en: Warehouse Management System (WMS): This is the core tool for controlling product status. It must be able to indicate quarantine status, assign product status accurately, and restrict the authority to change status.

blocks.zh: Quarantine 就像機場的安檢等候區：旅客（產品）在通過安檢（品質放行）之前，都被限制在特定區域內，不能進入登機門（不能出貨給客戶）。而 WMS 就像機場的旅客管理系統，能追蹤每位旅客的狀態（已報到、待安檢、已通關等），並確保只有持有效登機證的旅客才能登機。
blocks.en: Quarantine is like the security checkpoint waiting area at an airport: until passengers (products) pass security screening (quality release), they are confined to a specific area and cannot go to the boarding gate (cannot be shipped to customers). The WMS is like the airport passenger management system, which tracks the status of each passenger (checked in, waiting for screening, cleared, and so on) and ensures that only passengers with a valid boarding pass can board.

blocks.zh: 隔離品的跨廠區移轉是允許的，但必須滿足三個條件：(1) 有控制措施防止隔離品出貨給客戶；(2) 收發雙方的品質部門都有書面核准；(3) WMS 系統能確保狀態標示、分配和變更權限的正確性。
blocks.en: Transfer of quarantined product between sites is permitted, but three conditions must be met: (1) controls are in place to prevent quarantined product from being shipped to customers; (2) the quality units of both the sending and receiving sites have given written approval; (3) the WMS can ensure that status indication, assignment, and the authority to change status are correct.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：狀態變更的「權限控制」是關鍵，只有經過授權的人員才能將產品從「隔離」變更為「放行」，這是防止未放行產品誤出貨的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: Note in particular: "authority control" over status changes is the key. Only authorized personnel may change a product from "quarantine" to "released", and this is the last line of defense against the accidental shipment of unreleased product.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 WMS 系統發生故障，無法正確顯示產品狀態，你應該採取什麼應變措施？
blocks.en: If your WMS fails and cannot display product status correctly, what contingency measures should you take?

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement（品質協議）在隔離品跨廠移轉中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: What role does a Quality Agreement play in the transfer of quarantined product between sites?

blocks.zh: 3.2.3.3 Controlled Drugs 管制藥品
blocks.en: 3.2.3.3 Controlled Drugs

blocks.zh: Controlled Drugs (管制藥品)：指受到法規嚴格管控的藥物（如麻醉藥品、精神科藥物等），其進口、倉儲、運輸、處理、記錄和官方報告都必須遵守當地法規要求。
blocks.en: Controlled Drugs: Drugs that are strictly controlled by regulation (such as narcotics and psychotropic drugs). Their import, storage, transport, handling, records, and official reporting must all comply with local regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 跨國進出口時，配銷中心和接收國雙方都有責任溝通並執行相關法規要求。這意味著不能只遵守出口國的法規，還必須了解並遵守進口國的規定。
blocks.en: For international import and export, both the distribution center and the receiving country are responsible for communicating and implementing the relevant regulatory requirements. This means you cannot comply only with the regulations of the exporting country; you must also know and comply with the rules of the importing country.

blocks.zh: 管制藥品的配銷就像跨國運送黃金：不僅要遵守出發國的出口規定，還要遵守目的地國的進口規定；運輸途中需要特別的安保措施、詳細的文件記錄、且每一步都要向主管機關報告。雙方都有責任確保合規，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Distribution of controlled drugs is like shipping gold across borders: you must comply not only with the export rules of the country of departure but also with the import rules of the destination country; special security measures are needed in transit, detailed documentation is required, and every step must be reported to the competent authority. Both parties are responsible for ensuring compliance, and neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 管制藥品的法規要求因國而異，差異可能很大。在台灣，管制藥品的管理依據《管制藥品管理條例》，需取得管制藥品登記證，且進出口需事先申請許可。GDP 從業人員必須熟悉各國的特定要求，特別是在建立國際配銷網路時。
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements for controlled drugs differ from country to country, sometimes greatly. In Taiwan, the management of controlled drugs is based on the Controlled Drugs Act; a controlled drug registration certificate must be obtained, and import and export require prior permission. GDP practitioners must be familiar with the specific requirements of each country, especially when establishing an international distribution network.

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司需要將管制藥品從台灣出口到東南亞某國，你需要準備哪些文件和許可？
blocks.en: If your company needs to export controlled drugs from Taiwan to a country in Southeast Asia, what documents and permits do you need to prepare?

blocks.zh: 為什麼本段強調「雙方都有責任」而非只有出口方負責？
blocks.en: Why does this paragraph stress that "both parties are responsible" rather than only the exporter?

blocks.zh: 3.2.3.4 Counterfeit Products 偽藥
blocks.en: 3.2.3.4 Counterfeit Products

blocks.zh: Counterfeit Products (偽藥/仿冒產品)：在配銷網路中發現的偽藥必須：
blocks.en: Counterfeit Products: Counterfeit products found in the distribution network must be:

blocks.zh: 與可銷售產品完全隔離，存放在受限且受控的區域
blocks.en: Completely segregated from saleable product and kept in a restricted, controlled area

blocks.zh: 清楚標示「不得銷售」
blocks.en: Clearly labeled "Not for Sale"

blocks.zh: 立即通報主管機關（Competent Authorities）和原產品的上市許可持有人（Marketing Authorization Holder）
blocks.en: Reported immediately to the Competent Authorities and the Marketing Authorization Holder of the original product

blocks.zh: 依照法規進行處理
blocks.en: Handled in accordance with regulations

blocks.zh: 發現偽藥就像在銀行發現偽鈔：你不能把偽鈔混在真鈔裡（隔離），要明確標記它是偽的（標示），必須立即報警（通報主管機關），並通知央行（原產品的上市許可持有人），最後按照法律規定處理這些偽鈔。任何延遲都可能讓偽藥流入患者手中，造成嚴重後果。
blocks.en: Finding a counterfeit product is like finding a counterfeit banknote at a bank: you cannot mix it with genuine notes (segregation), you must mark it clearly as counterfeit (labeling), you must call the police immediately (report to the competent authority) and notify the central bank (the Marketing Authorization Holder of the original product), and finally you dispose of it as the law requires. Any delay could let counterfeit medicines reach patients, with serious consequences.

blocks.zh: 注意用語「should be informed immediately」——這是整個 TR52 中少數使用「立即」一詞的地方，凸顯了偽藥通報的緊急性。偽藥問題不僅是品質問題，更是患者安全問題和法律問題，任何延遲通報都可能危及患者生命並使公司面臨法律風險。
blocks.en: Note the wording "should be informed immediately". This is one of the few places in TR52 that uses the word "immediately", which highlights the urgency of reporting counterfeits. A counterfeit medicine is not only a quality issue but also a patient safety and legal issue; any delay in reporting can endanger patients' lives and expose the company to legal risk.

blocks.zh: 如果倉庫人員在驗收時懷疑某批產品可能是偽藥，他應該採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: If warehouse personnel suspect during receipt that a batch may be counterfeit, what steps should they take?

blocks.zh: 為什麼必須同時通報主管機關「和」原產品的上市許可持有人？只通報一方不夠嗎？
blocks.en: Why must both the competent authority "and" the Marketing Authorization Holder of the original product be notified? Is notifying only one party not enough?

blocks.zh: 3.2.3.5 Records 記錄
blocks.en: 3.2.3.5 Records

blocks.zh: Records (記錄)：GDP 對記錄有三個核心要求：
blocks.en: Records: GDP has three core requirements for records:

blocks.zh: 即時性 (Timeliness)：記錄必須在操作完成時立即生成，不能事後補記
blocks.en: Timeliness: Records must be generated at the time each operation is completed, not filled in afterward

blocks.zh: 可追溯性 (Traceability)：所有重要活動或事件都必須可追溯
blocks.en: Traceability: All significant activities or events must be traceable

blocks.zh: 可讀性與可得性 (Understandable & Readily Available)：記錄必須易於理解且隨時可調閱
blocks.en: Understandable & Readily Available: Records must be easy to understand and available for review at any time

blocks.zh: Records Retention Schedule (記錄保存時程)：必須依據適用法規建立文件保存期限。
blocks.en: Records Retention Schedule: A document retention period must be established in accordance with applicable regulations.

blocks.zh: GDP 記錄就像飛機的黑盒子（飛行記錄器）：它必須即時記錄（不能事後回憶），必須記錄所有重要事件（可追溯），且記錄內容必須是標準化的格式以便解讀（可讀性）。當需要調查時，必須能快速找到並讀取（可得性）。而記錄保存期限就像黑盒子的數據保存規定，依照法規明確規定。
blocks.en: GDP records are like an aircraft black box (flight recorder): it must record in real time (not from memory afterward), it must record all significant events (traceability), and its contents must be in a standardized format so that they can be interpreted (understandability). When an investigation is needed, the data must be quickly located and read (availability). The retention schedule is like the data retention rules for a black box, clearly specified by regulation.

blocks.zh: 「Generated at the time each operation is completed」這句話是 Good Documentation Practice (GDocP, 良好文件管理規範) 的核心原則之一。在稽核中，如果發現記錄是事後補填的（如字跡一致、墨水顏色相同等），會被視為嚴重缺失。電子系統的 Audit Trail（稽核軌跡）功能可以有效確保記錄的即時性和完整性。
blocks.en: The sentence "Generated at the time each operation is completed" is one of the core principles of Good Documentation Practice (GDocP). In an audit, if records are found to have been filled in after the fact (for example, uniform handwriting or the same ink color), this is treated as a serious deficiency. The audit trail function of electronic systems can effectively ensure the timeliness and integrity of records.

blocks.zh: 在你的工作中，哪些記錄是必須即時填寫的？如果無法即時記錄（如系統當機），應該如何處理？
blocks.en: In your work, which records must be completed in real time? If real-time recording is not possible (for example, a system crash), how should this be handled?

blocks.zh: Record retention schedule 的期限通常由哪些因素決定？（提示：法規要求、產品有效期等）
blocks.en: What factors usually determine the record retention schedule? (Hint: regulatory requirements, product shelf life, and so on)

blocks.zh: 3.2.4 Storage and Inventory Control 儲存與庫存控制
blocks.en: 3.2.4 Storage and Inventory Control

blocks.zh: Storage and Inventory Control (儲存與庫存控制)：必須追蹤的關鍵產品資訊包括：
blocks.en: Storage and Inventory Control: The key product information that must be tracked includes:

blocks.zh: Lot Numbers (批號)：產品追溯的基礎單位
blocks.en: Lot Numbers: The basic unit for product traceability

blocks.zh: Expiration Dates (有效期)：確保產品在有效期內配送
blocks.en: Expiration Dates: To ensure product is distributed within its shelf life

blocks.zh: Storage Locations (儲位)：知道產品在哪裡
blocks.en: Storage Locations: To know where the product is

blocks.zh: Product Status (產品狀態)：on test（待檢）、approved（核准）、quarantined（隔離）、restricted（受限）
blocks.en: Product Status: on test, approved, quarantined, restricted

blocks.zh: Cycle Counts (循環盤點)：定期（非一次性）的庫存盤點方式，比年度總盤點更能及時發現差異。
blocks.en: Cycle Counts: A periodic (not one-time) method of counting inventory that detects discrepancies sooner than an annual physical inventory.

blocks.zh: In-Transit Storage (在途儲存)：產品在運輸途中暫存的設施，如轉運中心、機場等，同樣需要安全和環境控制。
blocks.en: In-Transit Storage: Facilities where product is held temporarily during transport, such as transfer hubs and airports, which likewise require security and environmental control.

blocks.zh: 庫存控制就像圖書館管理系統：每本書（每批產品）都有一個唯一編號（批號），有借閱期限（有效期），有固定的書架位置（儲位），以及狀態標記（可借閱/已借出/維修中 = 核准/出貨中/隔離中）。圖書館會定期盤點（cycle counts）以確保書目系統和實際藏書一致。而 In-Transit Storage 就像書籍在圖書館之間的轉運站，即使是暫存，也需要適當的保護。
blocks.en: Inventory control is like a library management system: every book (every lot) has a unique number (lot number), a loan period (expiration date), a fixed shelf location (storage location), and a status flag (available / on loan / under repair = approved / being shipped / quarantined). The library takes periodic stock counts (cycle counts) to make sure the catalog agrees with the books actually on the shelves. In-transit storage is like a relay station where books move between libraries: even if it is only temporary storage, appropriate protection is needed.

blocks.zh: 注意兩個關鍵用語差異：
blocks.en: Note two key differences in wording:

blocks.zh: "should be...qualified and validated"：電腦化系統不僅要安裝確認（qualified），還要經過驗證（validated），證明其功能符合預期用途
blocks.en: "should be...qualified and validated": A computerized system must not only be qualified at installation but also validated to demonstrate that its functions meet the intended use

blocks.zh: "must be maintained and verified"：庫存準確性使用了「must」而非「should」，表示這是強制要求，而非建議
blocks.en: "must be maintained and verified": For inventory accuracy the text uses "must" rather than "should", which means this is a mandatory requirement, not a recommendation

blocks.zh: Product Status Control 中特別強調狀態變更只能由「appropriate quality personnel」（適當品質人員）執行，這是防止誤出貨的關鍵控制。
blocks.en: Product Status Control specifically emphasizes that status changes may only be made by "appropriate quality personnel". This is a key control to prevent accidental shipment.

blocks.zh: Cycle counts（循環盤點）與年度總盤點各有什麼優缺點？為什麼 TR52 同時提及兩者？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of cycle counts compared with an annual physical inventory? Why does TR52 mention both?

blocks.zh: In-transit storage 設施（如機場轉運站）的環境控制為什麼特別困難？你能想到哪些實務挑戰？
blocks.en: Why is environmental control especially difficult in in-transit storage facilities (such as airport transfer hubs)? What practical challenges can you think of?

blocks.zh: 如果電腦化庫存管理系統顯示某批產品狀態為「approved」，但實際上該批產品尚未通過品質放行，可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: If the computerized inventory management system shows a batch as "approved" when it has not actually passed quality release, what consequences could result?

blocks.zh: 3.2.5 Transportation 運輸
blocks.en: 3.2.5 Transportation

blocks.zh: Transportation (運輸)：運輸過程中需保護產品免受五大威脅：
blocks.en: Transportation: During transport, product must be protected against five major threats:

blocks.zh: 失去標識 (identification loss)
blocks.en: Loss of identification

blocks.zh: 交叉污染 (cross-contamination)
blocks.en: Cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 物理損壞或失竊 (spillage, breakage, theft)
blocks.en: Spillage, breakage, or theft

blocks.zh: 環境因素 (heat, cold, light, moisture)
blocks.en: Environmental factors (heat, cold, light, moisture)

blocks.zh: 蟲害 (pests)
blocks.en: Pests

blocks.zh: Validation Studies (驗證研究)：運輸時間不得超過驗證研究所建立的時限。如果發生溫度偏移（excursion），可以通過持續溫度監測和穩定性研究來論證產品仍然合格。
blocks.en: Validation Studies: Transit time must not exceed the time limit established by the validation studies. If a temperature excursion occurs, continuous temperature monitoring and stability studies can be used to justify that the product remains acceptable.

blocks.zh: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations (IATA 易腐貨物法規)：國際航運中溫控產品的標示標準。
blocks.en: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations: The labeling standard for temperature-controlled products in international air freight.

blocks.zh: Carrier Studies (承運商研究)：評估運輸工具適用性的研究，結合 Performance Qualification (PQ, 性能確認) 來證明運輸系統能在實際條件下維持產品品質。
blocks.en: Carrier Studies: Studies that evaluate the suitability of the means of transport; combined with Performance Qualification (PQ), they demonstrate that the transport system can maintain product quality under actual conditions.

blocks.zh: 藥品運輸就像護送一位對環境極度敏感的 VIP 旅客：你需要確保他的身份標示不會搞混（identification），不會與其他乘客互相干擾（cross-contamination），人身安全有保障（security），不會暴露在極端天氣中（environmental control），且旅途不受蟲害困擾（pest control）。而 carrier study 就像事先試跑一趟路線，確認車輛、路線和時間都能滿足這位 VIP 的特殊需求。
blocks.en: Transporting medicines is like escorting a VIP passenger who is extremely sensitive to the environment: you must make sure his identity labeling is not confused (identification), that he does not interfere with other passengers (cross-contamination), that his personal safety is assured (security), that he is not exposed to extreme weather (environmental control), and that the journey is free of pests (pest control). A carrier study is like a trial run of the route beforehand to confirm that the vehicle, route, and time can meet the VIP's special needs.

blocks.zh: 監測點位：車輛至少需要在前部和後部進行溫度監測，因為這兩個位置的溫差通常最大
blocks.en: Monitoring points: Vehicles need temperature monitoring at least at the front and rear, because the temperature difference between these two positions is usually the largest

blocks.zh: 裝載前檢查：每次裝載前都必須檢查車輛的清潔度和溫度設定，並留下文件記錄
blocks.en: Pre-loading checks: The cleanliness and temperature setting of the vehicle must be checked before every loading and documented

blocks.zh: 冷媒管理：用於冷鏈包裝的凝膠冰袋（gel packs）的冷凍櫃和控制流程也需要經過確認（qualified）
blocks.en: Refrigerant management: The freezers and control processes used for gel packs in cold chain packaging also need to be qualified

blocks.zh: 國際運輸：溫控產品的國際航運必須依照 IATA 規範標示
blocks.en: International transport: International air freight of temperature-controlled products must be labeled in accordance with IATA requirements

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你負責建立一條從台灣到東南亞的冷鏈藥品運輸路線。你需要考慮：
blocks.en: Suppose you are responsible for establishing a cold chain medicine transport lane from Taiwan to Southeast Asia. You need to consider:

blocks.zh: 選擇合格的承運商並進行 Carrier Study
blocks.en: Selecting a qualified carrier and conducting a Carrier Study

blocks.zh: 確認包裝系統（含凝膠冰袋）已經過驗證
blocks.en: Confirming that the packaging system (including gel packs) has been validated

blocks.zh: 在車輛/貨櫃前後至少兩點設置溫度監測器
blocks.en: Placing temperature monitors in at least two points, front and rear, of the vehicle/container

blocks.zh: 確保運輸時間不超過驗證時限
blocks.en: Ensuring that transit time does not exceed the validated time limit

blocks.zh: 依照 IATA 規範進行標示
blocks.en: Labeling in accordance with IATA requirements

blocks.zh: 建立裝載前的車輛檢查 SOP 並留存記錄
blocks.en: Establishing a pre-loading vehicle inspection SOP and retaining the records

blocks.zh: 為什麼溫度監測需要在車輛「前部和後部」至少兩個位置？如果只放一個監測器會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does temperature monitoring require at least two positions, "front and rear", of the vehicle? What problems would arise if only one monitor were used?

blocks.zh: 「Excursions may be justified through continuous temperature monitoring and appropriate stability studies」——溫度偏移的「論證」（justification）具體需要包含哪些內容？
blocks.en: "Excursions may be justified through continuous temperature monitoring and appropriate stability studies": what exactly must the "justification" of a temperature excursion contain?

blocks.zh: 3.2.6 Product Disposition and Distribution 產品處置與配銷
blocks.en: 3.2.6 Product Disposition and Distribution

blocks.zh: FEFO (First Expiry, First Out, 先到期先出)：不同於一般倉儲的 FIFO（先進先出），藥品配銷採用 FEFO 原則——有效期最近的產品優先出貨，以避免產品過期浪費和過期藥流入市場。
blocks.en: FEFO (First Expiry, First Out): Unlike the FIFO (first in, first out) commonly used in general warehousing, pharmaceutical distribution follows the FEFO principle: product with the nearest expiry date is shipped first, to avoid waste from expiry and to keep expired medicines from reaching the market.

blocks.zh: Authorized Parties (授權方)：藥品只能配送給有資格接收和/或供應藥品的授權對象，這是確保供應鏈安全的基本原則。
blocks.en: Authorized Parties: Medicines may be distributed only to authorized parties who are entitled to receive and/or supply medicines. This is a basic principle for ensuring supply chain security.

blocks.zh: 隨附文件必須包含的資訊：日期、藥品名稱與劑型、供應數量、供應商名稱與地址、出貨數量、批號。
blocks.en: The accompanying documents must include the following information: date, name and dosage form of the medicine, quantity supplied, name and address of the supplier, quantity shipped, and lot number.

blocks.zh: FEFO 就像超市管理牛奶的方式：保質期最近的牛奶放在貨架前面，讓消費者先買走，以減少過期浪費。但藥品的 FEFO 更嚴格，因為過期藥品不僅是浪費問題，更是安全問題。而配送時間的協調就像安排精密的物流拼圖：你不僅要考慮路程時間，還要避開假日、週末、海關延遲等「時間陷阱」，確保產品在最短時間內到達客戶手中。
blocks.en: FEFO is like the way a supermarket manages milk: the milk closest to its expiry date is placed at the front of the shelf so that consumers buy it first, which reduces waste from expiry. But FEFO for medicines is stricter, because an expired medicine is not just a matter of waste but a matter of safety. Coordinating delivery timing is like arranging a precise logistics puzzle: you must consider not only the travel time but also avoid "time traps" such as holidays, weekends, and customs delays, so that the product reaches the customer in the shortest possible time.

blocks.zh: 跨國出貨特別需要注意的「時間陷阱」：
blocks.en: "Time traps" that need particular attention in international shipments:

blocks.zh: 海關延遲：不同國家的海關效率差異很大，有些國家可能需要數天甚至數週
blocks.en: Customs delays: Customs efficiency varies greatly between countries, and some may take days or even weeks

blocks.zh: FDA 扣押：美國 FDA 可能對進口藥品進行抽查扣押
blocks.en: FDA detention: The US FDA may detain imported medicines for sampling inspection

blocks.zh: 假日差異：各國假日不同，週末定義也可能不同（如中東的週五-週六休假）
blocks.en: Holiday differences: Holidays differ between countries, and even the definition of the weekend may differ (for example, Friday-Saturday in the Middle East)

blocks.zh: 天氣因素：颱風、暴風雪等極端天氣可能導致交通中斷
blocks.en: Weather: Extreme weather such as typhoons and snowstorms can disrupt transport

blocks.zh: 這些延遲不僅影響交貨時間，更可能影響溫控產品的品質。規劃出貨時必須將這些因素納入考量。
blocks.en: These delays affect not only delivery time but may also affect the quality of temperature-controlled products. These factors must be taken into account when planning shipments.

blocks.zh: FEFO 與 FIFO 有什麼不同？在什麼情況下兩者的出貨順序會不一致？
blocks.en: How does FEFO differ from FIFO? Under what circumstances would the two shipping sequences be inconsistent?

blocks.zh: 如果一批冷鏈藥品在海關被延滯了 48 小時，你應該採取哪些措施來評估產品品質？
blocks.en: If a batch of cold chain medicines is held up at customs for 48 hours, what measures should you take to assess product quality?

blocks.zh: 3.2.7 Product Protection 產品保護
blocks.en: 3.2.7 Product Protection

blocks.zh: Product Protection (產品保護)：這是 GDP 品質系統的根本目標。需要保護產品免受的環境因素包括：
blocks.en: Product Protection: This is the fundamental goal of the GDP quality system. The environmental factors from which product must be protected include:

blocks.zh: 化學物質（chemicals）
blocks.en: Chemicals

blocks.zh: 光照（light）
blocks.en: Light

blocks.zh: 濕度（moisture）
blocks.en: Moisture

blocks.zh: 溫度（temperature）
blocks.en: Temperature

blocks.zh: 蟲害（pest infestation）
blocks.en: Pest infestation

blocks.zh: 微生物和/或化學污染（microbial/chemical contamination）
blocks.en: Microbial and/or chemical contamination

blocks.zh: Stability Testing (穩定性測試)：透過穩定性測試建立產品的降解途徑（paths to degradation），進而定義所需的運輸條件。
blocks.en: Stability Testing: Stability testing establishes the product's paths to degradation, which in turn define the required transport conditions.

blocks.zh: Forced Degradation Studies (強制降解研究)：故意在極端條件下測試產品的降解行為，以了解產品在不利條件下的反應。
blocks.en: Forced Degradation Studies: The product is deliberately tested under extreme conditions to understand how it degrades and reacts under adverse conditions.

blocks.zh: Temperature Cycling Studies (溫度循環研究)：模擬產品在運輸過程中可能經歷的反覆溫度變化。
blocks.en: Temperature Cycling Studies: These simulate the repeated temperature changes a product may experience during transport.

blocks.zh: Product Protection 就像保護一幅珍貴畫作的運輸過程：你需要了解這幅畫對光線、濕度、溫度、震動的敏感程度（stability testing），也需要知道在極端條件下畫作會如何受損（forced degradation），然後根據這些知識來選擇合適的包裝、運輸工具和路線。而破損包裝的產品就像有裂痕的畫框——即使畫作本身可能還好，也必須先隔離檢查，不能繼續展出。
blocks.en: Product Protection is like shipping a valuable painting: you need to know how sensitive the painting is to light, humidity, temperature, and vibration (stability testing), and you also need to know how it would be damaged under extreme conditions (forced degradation); you then use this knowledge to choose suitable packaging, transport, and routes. A product in damaged packaging is like a cracked picture frame: even if the painting itself may be fine, it must first be segregated and examined and cannot stay on display.

blocks.zh: 本段特別提到殺蟲劑計畫（pesticide program）必須使用當地法規認可的殺蟲劑——這看似細節，但使用未經註冊的殺蟲劑可能導致藥品受到化學污染
blocks.en: This paragraph specifically mentions that the pesticide program must use pesticides approved under local regulations. This may seem like a detail, but using unregistered pesticides could cause chemical contamination of the medicines

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據（stability data）不僅用於產品註冊，也是定義供應鏈溫度控制策略的科學依據
blocks.en: Stability data are used not only for product registration but also as the scientific basis for defining the temperature control strategy of the supply chain

blocks.zh: 破損或疑似受污染的產品如果不立即銷毀，必須「隔離、保安、待驗」三步驟處理，絕對不能繼續留在可銷售庫存中
blocks.en: Damaged or suspected contaminated product, if not destroyed immediately, must be handled in three steps ("segregate, secure, and hold for disposition") and must never remain in saleable inventory

blocks.zh: Stability testing、forced degradation studies 和 temperature cycling studies 三者有什麼不同？它們分別回答了什麼問題？
blocks.en: How do stability testing, forced degradation studies, and temperature cycling studies differ? What question does each of them answer?

blocks.zh: 為什麼本段強調「adequate space for the orderly placement of materials」（充足的空間以有序擺放物料）？空間不足會導致什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does this paragraph stress "adequate space for the orderly placement of materials"? What risks result from insufficient space?

blocks.zh: 3.2.8 Returns Management 退貨管理
blocks.en: 3.2.8 Returns Management

blocks.zh: Returns Management (退貨管理)：退回的產品只有兩種結局——銷毀或重新入庫。重新入庫的門檻極高，必須同時滿足四個條件：
blocks.en: Returns Management: Returned product has only two possible outcomes: destruction or return to stock. The bar for return to stock is very high, and all four of the following conditions must be met:

blocks.zh: 包裝完整：原始、未開封、完好無損
blocks.en: Intact packaging: Original, unopened, and undamaged

blocks.zh: 授權評估：經過授權人員評估
blocks.en: Authorized evaluation: Evaluated by authorized personnel

blocks.zh: 溫度證明：有文件證明溫度始終在要求範圍內
blocks.en: Temperature evidence: Documentation shows that the temperature stayed within the required range throughout

blocks.zh: Chain of Custody (保管鏈)：有文件記錄退貨原因，且產品未被客戶入庫，保管鏈完整
blocks.en: Chain of Custody: The reason for the return is documented, the product has not been put into stock by the customer, and the chain of custody is intact

blocks.zh: Chain of Custody (保管鏈)：產品從製造到最終用戶（或退回）的每一步都有明確的責任人和記錄，確保產品始終處於受控狀態。
blocks.en: Chain of Custody: At every step from manufacture to the end user (or return), there is a clearly responsible person and a record, ensuring that the product remains under control at all times.

blocks.zh: 退貨管理就像法院對物證的管理：一旦物證離開了保管鏈（chain of custody），就不能再作為有效證據使用。同樣地，一旦藥品離開了受控的供應鏈，且無法證明它在整個過程中都受到妥善保管，就不能再重新入庫銷售——因為你無法確定它是否被篡改、暴露在不當環境中、或以其他方式受損。
blocks.en: Returns management is like how a court manages physical evidence: once evidence leaves the chain of custody, it can no longer be used as valid evidence. Likewise, once a medicine leaves the controlled supply chain and it cannot be shown that it was properly held throughout, it cannot be returned to stock and sold, because you cannot be sure whether it was tampered with, exposed to an inappropriate environment, or otherwise damaged.

blocks.zh: 本段有一個非常重要的實務備註：「many companies do not receive cold chain back into stock due in part to inconsistencies in controls for the return shipment」（許多公司不接受冷鏈產品退貨重新入庫，部分原因是退貨運輸過程中的控制不一致）。
blocks.en: This paragraph contains a very important practical note: "many companies do not receive cold chain back into stock due in part to inconsistencies in controls for the return shipment".

blocks.zh: 這反映了一個業界現實：冷鏈退貨的溫度控制往往不如正向出貨嚴格。大多數公司選擇直接銷毀冷鏈退貨，因為驗證退貨過程中溫度是否始終受控的成本和風險太高。這也是為什麼冷鏈藥品的出貨協調（參見 3.2.6）特別重要——預防退貨比處理退貨更經濟。
blocks.en: This reflects an industry reality: temperature control for cold chain returns is often less strict than for outbound shipments. Most companies choose to destroy cold chain returns outright, because the cost and risk of verifying that the temperature was controlled throughout the return process is too high. This is also why coordinating cold chain shipments (see 3.2.6) is so important: preventing returns is more economical than handling them.

blocks.zh: 為什麼大多數公司選擇不將冷鏈退貨重新入庫？除了溫度控制不一致之外，還有哪些考量？
blocks.en: Why do most companies choose not to return cold chain returns to stock? Besides inconsistent temperature control, what other considerations are there?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶要求退回一批常溫儲存的藥品（退貨原因是訂單錯誤），你會如何評估該批產品是否符合重新入庫的條件？
blocks.en: If a customer asks to return a batch of medicines stored at room temperature (the reason for the return is an order error), how would you assess whether the batch meets the conditions for return to stock?

blocks.zh: 3.2.9 Exception Management 異常管理
blocks.en: 3.2.9 Exception Management

blocks.zh: Exception Management (異常管理)：任何偏離已定義流程的情況都構成一個 Exception（異常）。異常管理系統必須能夠：
blocks.en: Exception Management: Any deviation from a defined process constitutes an exception. The exception management system must be able to:

blocks.zh: 追蹤所有 Non-Conformances（不符合項）
blocks.en: Track all non-conformances

blocks.zh: 調查不符合項的原因
blocks.en: Investigate the causes of non-conformances

blocks.zh: 評估對產品的影響（Product Impact）
blocks.en: Evaluate the impact on the product (product impact)

blocks.zh: 設定結案時限（targeted timeframe for closure）
blocks.en: Set a targeted timeframe for closure

blocks.zh: 定期向管理層報告（management review）
blocks.en: Report periodically to management (management review)

blocks.zh: 調查的深度應與問題的「重要性或風險程度」成正比——這體現了 Risk-Based Approach（基於風險的方法）的原則。
blocks.en: The depth of the investigation should be proportional to the "significance or level of risk" of the problem. This reflects the principle of a risk-based approach.

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統要素 CAPA System Elements
blocks.en: CAPA System Elements

blocks.zh: CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventive Action, 矯正與預防措施)：是品質系統的核心工具之一，包含七個關鍵要素：
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventive Action): One of the core tools of the quality system, with seven key elements:

blocks.zh: 調查描述
blocks.en: Description of the investigation

blocks.zh: Root Cause（根本原因）識別
blocks.en: Identification of the root cause

blocks.zh: 根本原因的識別方法描述
blocks.en: Description of the method used to identify the root cause

blocks.zh: 矯正措施與預防措施
blocks.en: Corrective actions and preventive actions

blocks.zh: 負責人與目標完成日期
blocks.en: Responsible person and targeted completion date

blocks.zh: 有效性驗證——確認措施已實施且有效
blocks.en: Effectiveness verification: confirming that the actions have been implemented and are effective

blocks.zh: 管理層審核證據
blocks.en: Evidence of management review

blocks.zh: Exception Management 就像醫院的醫療事故管理系統：
blocks.en: Exception Management is like a hospital medical incident management system:

blocks.zh: Exception（異常）：就像醫療不良事件——任何偏離標準操作的情況
blocks.en: Exception: Like a medical adverse event: any departure from standard practice

blocks.zh: CAPA：就像事故後的改善計畫——找出根本原因，採取矯正措施防止再發
blocks.en: CAPA: Like the improvement plan after an incident: find the root cause and take corrective action to prevent recurrence

blocks.zh: Complaints（客訴）：就像病人投訴——需要統一流程處理，且要追蹤趨勢
blocks.en: Complaints: Like patient complaints: they need a uniform handling process, and trends must be tracked

blocks.zh: Quality Holds（品質暫扣）：就像可疑藥品的緊急下架——防止問題產品到達患者手中
blocks.en: Quality Holds: Like an emergency withdrawal of a suspect medicine: prevent the problem product from reaching patients

blocks.zh: Product Action（產品行動）：就像大規模藥品召回——需要系統化的應對流程
blocks.en: Product Action: Like a large-scale medicine recall: it requires a systematic response process

blocks.zh: 幾個關鍵要點：
blocks.en: Several key points:

blocks.zh: CAPA 中的「if one exists」：注意 Root Cause 後面加了「if one exists」，承認有時候根本原因確實無法找到。但這不代表可以隨意放棄追根究底
blocks.en: "If one exists" in CAPA: Note that "if one exists" is added after root cause, acknowledging that sometimes a root cause truly cannot be found. This does not mean that one may give up the search for the root cause at will

blocks.zh: Complaints 的趨勢分析：客訴不僅要個別處理，還要進行 Track and Trend（追蹤與趨勢分析），因為單個客訴可能看似小事，但多個相似客訴可能揭示系統性問題
blocks.en: Trend analysis of complaints: Complaints must be not only handled individually but also tracked and trended, because a single complaint may seem minor, but several similar complaints may reveal a systemic problem

blocks.zh: Quality Holds 的權限控制：暫扣/放行的權限必須限制給「properly trained and authorized」的品質人員，這是防止未經授權放行的最後防線
blocks.en: Authority control for Quality Holds: The authority to hold and release must be limited to "properly trained and authorized" quality personnel; this is the last line of defense against unauthorized release

blocks.zh: Product Action 的三種類型：Recalls（召回）、Withdrawals（撤回）和 Corrections（更正）是三種不同層級的產品行動，嚴重程度依次遞減
blocks.en: Three types of Product Action: Recalls, Withdrawals, and Corrections are three different levels of product action, in descending order of severity

blocks.zh: 假設你的倉庫發生了一次溫度偏移事件（冷庫溫度升至 12°C 持續 4 小時，而要求範圍是 2-8°C）。你需要啟動以下流程：
blocks.en: Suppose a temperature excursion occurs in your warehouse (the cold room temperature rises to 12°C for 4 hours, while the required range is 2-8°C). You need to start the following process:

blocks.zh: Exception 記錄：記錄偏移發生的時間、持續時間、影響範圍
blocks.en: Exception record: Record when the excursion occurred, its duration, and the extent of impact

blocks.zh: Quality Hold：立即暫扣所有受影響產品，防止出貨
blocks.en: Quality Hold: Immediately place all affected product on hold to prevent shipment

blocks.zh: 調查：找出溫度偏移的根本原因（如冷凍機故障、門未關好等）
blocks.en: Investigation: Find the root cause of the temperature excursion (for example, a refrigeration unit failure or a door left open)

blocks.zh: Product Impact 評估：根據穩定性數據評估產品是否仍然合格
blocks.en: Product Impact assessment: Use stability data to assess whether the product is still acceptable

blocks.zh: CAPA：制定矯正措施（如維修設備）和預防措施（如增加備用冷凍機）
blocks.en: CAPA: Define corrective actions (such as repairing the equipment) and preventive actions (such as adding a backup refrigeration unit)

blocks.zh: Management Review：向管理層報告事件及處置結果
blocks.en: Management Review: Report the event and its disposition to management

blocks.zh: Recalls、Withdrawals 和 Corrections 三種產品行動有什麼不同？各自在什麼情況下啟動？
blocks.en: How do Recalls, Withdrawals, and Corrections differ? In what circumstances is each initiated?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CAPA 必須包含「有效性驗證」？如果省略這一步會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must CAPA include "effectiveness verification"? What risks arise if this step is omitted?

blocks.zh: 客訴的「趨勢分析」如何幫助發現系統性問題？請舉一個例子。
blocks.en: How does complaint "trend analysis" help to detect systemic problems? Give an example.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 配銷控制管理（3.2）是 GDP 的核心章節，涵蓋從產品接收到配送的所有流程控制
blocks.en: Distribution Control Management (3.2) is the core section of GDP, covering control of all processes from product receipt to delivery

blocks.zh: 人員（3.2.1）：背景調查防止產品挪用；SOP 覆蓋所有崗位；培訓計畫包含初始和持續培訓，記錄必須留存
blocks.en: Personnel (3.2.1): Background checks prevent product diversion; SOPs cover all positions; the training program includes initial and ongoing training, and records must be retained

blocks.zh: 廠房與設備（3.2.2）：倉庫必須滿足安全性、結構完整性和環境控制三大類要求
blocks.en: Premises and Equipment (3.2.2): The warehouse must meet three categories of requirements: security, structural integrity, and environmental control

blocks.zh: 物料處理（3.2.3）：接收區與儲存區分開；驗收檢查外觀、供應商、完整性和訂單吻合；隔離品跨廠移轉需品質雙方書面核准；管制藥品和偽藥有特殊處理要求；記錄必須即時生成且可追溯
blocks.en: Material Handling (3.2.3): Separate receiving and storage areas; receipt inspection covers condition, supplier, integrity, and order match; transfer of quarantined product between sites requires written approval from the quality units of both sites; controlled drugs and counterfeit products have special handling requirements; records must be generated in real time and be traceable

blocks.zh: 儲存與庫存控制（3.2.4）：追蹤批號、有效期、儲位和產品狀態；循環盤點維護庫存準確性；產品狀態變更限品質人員；在途儲存設施同樣需要安全和環控
blocks.en: Storage and Inventory Control (3.2.4): Track lot numbers, expiration dates, storage locations, and product status; cycle counts maintain inventory accuracy; product status changes are restricted to quality personnel; in-transit storage facilities also require security and environmental control

blocks.zh: 運輸（3.2.5）：保護產品免受五大威脅；溫控運輸需驗證和監測；車輛裝載前須檢查並記錄
blocks.en: Transportation (3.2.5): Protect product against five major threats; temperature-controlled transport requires validation and monitoring; vehicles must be inspected and the inspection recorded before loading

blocks.zh: 產品處置（3.2.6）：FEFO 原則防止過期藥出貨；隨附文件須包含完整產品與供應商資訊；協調出貨須考慮假日、海關等延遲因素
blocks.en: Product Disposition (3.2.6): The FEFO principle prevents expired medicines from being shipped; accompanying documents must include complete product and supplier information; coordinating shipments must take into account delays such as holidays and customs

blocks.zh: 產品保護（3.2.7）：基於穩定性數據定義環境控制策略；破損產品必須隔離處理
blocks.en: Product Protection (3.2.7): The environmental control strategy is defined on the basis of stability data; damaged product must be segregated and handled

blocks.zh: 退貨管理（3.2.8）：重新入庫須滿足四個嚴格條件；冷鏈退貨大多選擇銷毀；保管鏈完整性是核心考量
blocks.en: Returns Management (3.2.8): Return to stock requires meeting four strict conditions; cold chain returns are mostly destroyed; the integrity of the chain of custody is the core consideration

blocks.zh: 異常管理（3.2.9）：CAPA 系統包含七大要素；客訴須追蹤趨勢；品質暫扣限授權人員執行；產品行動包含召回、撤回和更正三種類型
blocks.en: Exception Management (3.2.9): The CAPA system has seven elements; complaints must be trended; quality holds are executed only by authorized personnel; product actions comprise three types: recalls, withdrawals, and corrections
